test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian startups was selected to develop the country's first indigenous large language model under the India AI Mission April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarvam AI**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sarvam AI** is an Indian startup selected to develop the country’s first indigenous large language model under the **India AI Mission** in April 2025.
 
• This initiative is a part of the Indian government’s focus on achieving **self-reliance in artificial intelligence** and strengthening AI capabilities within the country.
 
• The indigenous large language model by Sarvam AI aims to compete with international AI models like ChatGPT and Google Bard by being tailored specifically to India’s linguistic and cultural diversity.
 
• The India AI Mission is a flagship program aimed at fostering innovation in AI and promoting the development of AI infrastructure, tools, and technologies within India.
 
• Projects like this are expected to support India’s goal of becoming a global hub for AI innovation and technology by leveraging local talent and resources.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **AI4Bharat:**

 
 
• AI4Bharat is an initiative by the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras aimed at building open-source AI solutions for societal challenges in India.
 
• It focuses on creating AI tools and datasets specifically tailored for Indian languages and applications.
 
• While AI4Bharat has made significant strides in language processing, it is not selected for the India AI Mission's large language model project.
 
 
 
• **Infosys:**
 
 
• Infosys is one of India’s leading multinational corporations providing IT services, consulting, and outsourcing solutions.
 
• While Infosys has a strong focus on AI and machine learning, the development of India’s first indigenous large language model is not part of its current projects.
 
 
 
• **Wadhwani AI:**
 
 
• Wadhwani AI is a non-profit research institute leveraging artificial intelligence to address societal challenges in sectors like healthcare, agriculture, and education.
 
• Its primary focus is on applied AI solutions rather than developing large language models.
